AltaVie Health is a family-centric health clinic offering excellent and evidence-informed prenatal, perinatal and postnatal chiropractic care, massage therapy (RMT),  Naturopathic medicine, Registered Dietitian Support. We focus in serving the pediatric and maternity community, from preconception and pregnancy care to postnatal rehab and care for kids of all ages.

Looking for a pediatric chiropractor in Kelowna? AltaVie Health is the best pediatric chiropractic clinic in the Okanagan and surrounding areas.

Trying to find a great prenatal massage, our trained RMT's can assist.

Our team at AltaVie also includes a naturopath doctor and registered dietician .

Book your appointment here at AltaVie Health today by visiting 
https://altaviehealth.com, drop by or call us.
